Name: Co-op Config Sync
Author: TypicalVolpe
Description:
[size=5][b]Host Config Sync[/b][/size]
Everyone plays with the host's mod settings. Nobody gets kicked.

[size=4][b]A note first[/b][/size]
I made this mainly for myself and my own multiplayer games. I built it with AI assistance (Claude by Anthropic). Nexus doesn't allow mods to be private or hidden, so it's public here. It's shared as is: use it if it helps, but expect rough edges and back up your saves.

[size=4][b]IMPORTANT: the host AND every joining player need this mod, on the same version.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What it does[/b][/size]
In modded multiplayer, everyone's mod settings (config.json) can differ, which causes confusion. Host Config Sync makes the host's settings the standard, [b]once[/b].
[list]
[*][b]One-time sync:[/b] the first time a player joins, their differing mod configs are replaced with the host's automatically (no prompt). They see what changed and keep playing. The new settings load the next time they start the game.[/*]
[*][b]Then left alone:[/b] on later joins nothing is touched. Many mods rewrite their own config files, so re-checking every time would loop. This avoids that.[/*]
[*][b]The host decides when to re-sync:[/b] each time the host launches and hosts, an in-game prompt asks whether players should get the host's configs again. Yes starts a new sync round. No leaves everyone as they are.[/*]
[*][b]Host notifications:[/b] the host sees in the chat box which mod configs were updated for each player, and which mods they're missing.[/*]
[*][b]"List" button:[/b] joiners can see the full list of what was updated or is missing.[/*]
[*][b]Locked mod options:[/b] joining players can't open Generic Mod Config Menu in the host's world (on by default; the host can unlock).[/*]
[*][b]Backups:[/b] old config files are saved to a backups folder before being replaced.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Host commands (SMAPI console)[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]hcs_resync[/b]: start a new sync round now[/*]
[*][b]hcs_options lock|unlock[/b]: block or allow mod option menus for joiners[/*]
[*][b]hcs_mods[/b]: list every mod ID[/*]
[*][b]hcs_exclude add|remove ModId[/b]: skip a mod (never synced)[/*]
[*][b]hcs_status[/b] (joiner): show what matched, updated, failed or is missing[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+, SMAPI 4.0+[/*]
[*]Host and all joining players have the mod (same version)[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu is optional (for the in-game settings page)[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
Install like any SMAPI mod (Vortex or manually into the Mods folder). Everyone in the game needs it.

[size=4][b]Settings (config.json)[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]AskHostOnLaunch[/b] (true): the host is asked at launch whether to start a new sync round.[/*]
[*][b]ShareConfigsAsHost[/b] (true): the host lets joiners request its config files.[/*]
[*][b]SyncConfigsAsFarmhand[/b] (true): joiners take the host's configs once per round.[/*]
[*][b]CheckModList[/b] (true): the host is told which mods a joiner is missing. Informational only.[/*]
[*][b]FarmhandsCanEditModOptions[/b] (false): true lets joiners open mod option menus.[/*]
[*][b]LockedMenuNamespaces[/b] (["GenericModConfigMenu"]): menus closed while locked.[/*]
[*][b]ExcludedModIds[/b]: mods never synced (default: Mail Services Mod and Smartphone, which keep per-player data in their config).[/*]
[*][b]IncludedModIds[/b]: if set, only these mods are synced.[/*]
[*][b]MaxFileSizeKB[/b] (256): larger config files are skipped.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Known limitations[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Players must restart the game after their configs are updated. Other mods can't reload their settings while the game runs.[/*]
[*]Players are only synced once per round. If a mod rewrites its config afterwards, it won't be fixed until the host starts a new round.[/*]
[*]Mods that keep per-player data in their config (like Mail Services Mod) shouldn't be synced. Add them to ExcludedModIds.[/*]
[*]Only mods with a config.json are synced.[/*]
[*]The options lock is a "soft lock". It closes menus in game, but can't stop someone editing files on their own computer.[/*]
[*]Split-screen play is not supported.[/*]
[*]Host and joiners need the same version of this mod.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Source[/b][/size]
The source code is included in the download.

Manifest.Name: Host Config Sync
Manifest.Description: In multiplayer, joining players get the host's mod config.json files once (per sync round) so everyone's settings match. Backs up old files, never removes anyone, and locks mod option menus for joiners by default.
Manifest.Author: Local
